# Additive progress acceptance

Run node tests/godot-final-install-assets/progress-migration.test.mjs for the pure fixed-rule negative and preservation cases. Set CRAFTMINE_GODOT_CACHE_DIR to the locked cache and run node tests/godot-final-install-assets/progress-migration-native.mjs. It materializes a new authored FPS fixture and uses the pinned headless engine to capture actual defaults and real damage/equipment. Two successive scene additions preserve all old state. Reordered, duplicate, unknown, missing and invalid entries exercise the runtime by complete load/snapshot/rollback, without input or focus.

The parent integration must additionally test actual package source import, real check migration evidence, preview/apply, second independent import and restart. Stale formal progress after check and forged/modified default proofs must fail or be freshly re-derived with CAS, never erase progress.
